title: 2 months of dev and 1 month of apple store submission.
author: AthleticDonkey
selftext:
Hey guys, well, spent some good time. 757 builds to be precise on this one. On top of the backend work. 

I am an oldschool fan of retro city sim/transport sims. So decided why not, and went into this fun adventure. 

It was super time consuming to do similar project before, now if you know what you are doing it is very doable. With correct skills and time you can develop this solo. 

I spent a lot of time on how cities are growing and expanding, upgrading buildings in newer eras etc. Creating numerous various buildings and making rules for them to not crowd with the same looks. 

Economy and various resources that are creating a supply chain. Balancing the return on investments for the player, when you need to get some healthy margin after building and buying your fleet. 

All is quite interesting and something fresh to do. 

Lovely feeling when you finally get things to work and see how these cities are growing based on your actions. 

Let me know what you think. 

Game name is Haltwick in both appstore and google play. 

<3

comments.author: AthleticDonkey
comments.body: Oh and btw, some movement and animations in the preview are weird, because it was also generated with AI on a game source and files. It doesn't overlap or move weird like that in the game itself.
